title: Characterization of dual Fourier support
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$ whose additive structure is commutative, let $f:V\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $\psi$ be a linear functional from $V$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$. Then $\psi$ belongs to the dual Fourier support of $f$ if and only if the corresponding dual Fourier coefficient is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: Commutative additive group $V$ with an $\mathbb{F}_2$-module structure
